$comment: Components of the SBOM (doc/sbom.spdx.json) that scripts/create-sbom.sh cannot take from vcpkg. Licences are SPDX licence expressions; NOASSERTION marks a licence that is unclear. Determined in TASK-0024 and TASK-0025 from the licence files and source file headers; see doc/thirdparty.md.

vcpkgBuildHelpers.$comment: vcpkg ports that are only used to build the libraries and are not part of the app.

vcpkgOverrides.$comment: Corrections of vcpkg's data for single ports, e.g. a licence vcpkg does not declare.

libsigcpp.comment: vcpkg declares no licence for this port; licence from the headers of libsigc++ 2.10.0 (installed include/sigc++/) and its copyright file.

app.name: ASC for Mac
app.comment: The app bundle ASCforMac.app. As a combination of ASC (GPL-2.0-or-later) with the other components, the app as a whole is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later (licence analysis in doc/thirdparty.md, TASK-0025).

packages.name: asc-for-mac (own code)
packages.comment: The project's own code: the Swift app (app/), the C++ facade (facade/), the build files and scripts (core/, cmake/, scripts/). Licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later (LICENSE at the repository root; decision of the user in TASK-0025).

packages.name: Advanced Strategic Command (ASC)
packages.comment: The ASC core (thirdparty/asc/source/, without source/libs/), with the changes listed in doc/thirdparty.md. Licence from the source file headers and asc.appdata.xml.in; COPYING contains the GPL version 2.

packages.name: ASC game data
packages.comment: main.ascdat, asc2_dlg.zip and pbp.ascdat, built from thirdparty/asc/data/ and extra-data/. The data has no licence statement of its own; it is treated as covered by ASC's GPL, as ASC's packaging (asc.appdata.xml.in, asc.spec.in) and Debian's package do (decision of the user in TASK-0025).

packages.name: getopt (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: GNU getopt from thirdparty/asc/source/libs/getopt/; licence from the file headers.

packages.name: Loki (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: thirdparty/asc/source/libs/loki-0.1.6/; licence from the file headers.

packages.name: ParaGUI (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: Heavily patched ParaGUI from thirdparty/asc/source/libs/paragui/ (see source/libs/readme.txt); licence from the file headers (GNU Library General Public License, version 2 or later).

packages.name: rand_r (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: Random number generator from the GNU C Library in thirdparty/asc/source/libs/rand/, included by source/gamemap.cpp; licence from the file header.

packages.name: SDLmm (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: thirdparty/asc/source/libs/sdlmm/; licence from the file headers.

packages.name: triangul (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: Polygon triangulation after R. Seidel by Atul Narkhede (UNC-CH) in thirdparty/asc/source/libs/triangul/; its README puts the code in the public domain (found in TASK-0025).

packages.name: SDL_sound (bundled with ASC)
packages.comment: thirdparty/asc/source/libs/SDL_sound-2.0.4/ without its Timidity and libmodplug parts (separate packages); licence from LICENSE.txt.

packages.name: TiMidity (part of SDL_sound)
packages.comment: thirdparty/asc/source/libs/SDL_sound-2.0.4/src/timidity/; licence from its COPYING files (choice of the LGPL or the Perl Artistic License).

packages.name: libmodplug (part of SDL_sound)
packages.comment: thirdparty/asc/source/libs/SDL_sound-2.0.4/src/libmodplug/; the file headers declare the code public domain.
